Mission Local reported that three friends arrived at the Mission Street GameStop at 6 a.m. to buy the new Zelda game. Over the next three hours, about 10 other gamers joined the line. The friends hoped to get limited collector’s editions, and their early arrival secured the first three spots; Mike Carrillo was first to buy the game at 10 a.m.
